title: Find the running preview
responsibility: Reads the existing preview address and refuses a different checkout or history source.

inputs.name: previewOwner.port
inputs.description: Loopback TCP port on 127.0.0.1 whose /__harness_preview__ endpoint is probed on every attempt, so it decides which listener's status is read. The value is not range-checked, so a port with no listener makes fetch reject with a TypeError.

inputs.name: previewOwner.identity
inputs.description: Expected fingerprint of the checkout and selected history data, which must equal the owner's reported identity by strict string equality. The string is not format-checked, so any value is compared as-is and a mismatch throws the 'A different Harness preview is already running' error.

outputs.name: previewOwnerPort
outputs.description: Exported numeric constant 47840 named previewOwnerPort in utils/accounts-access/previewOwner.ts; the previewOwner function never reads it and uses only its port argument.

outputs.name: previewOwnerPath
outputs.description: Exported string constant '/__harness_preview__' from utils/accounts-access/previewOwner.ts, appended to http://127.0.0.1:<port> on every probe. The probe sets redirect to 'error', so a redirect fails the request instead of being followed.

outputs.name: previewOwner
outputs.description: Resolves to the owner's reported url only after the protocol, url and identity checks pass and that url is non-null; the value is always an http://127.0.0.1:<digits> address and is never null. Any failed check rejects, and so does a url that stays null across 100 attempts.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown with 'Preview ownership port is occupied by another application.' when the probe gets a non-OK status, a body longer than 2048 characters, or a JSON body whose protocol is not 'harness-preview-v1'.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown with 'Invalid preview owner address.' when the reported url is non-null but is not http://127.0.0.1:<digits>, which includes an empty string or a missing url field.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown with 'A different Harness preview is already running at <url>. Close it before switching checkout or history data.' when the reported identity is not equal to the requested identity; <url> is the reported url, or 'startup' when url is null.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown with 'The existing Harness preview is still starting; no duplicate was launched.' after 100 attempts in which the owner still reported a null url, each followed by a 100 ms wait.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Raised when the request or reading its body fails at the network level, including a refused connection and any redirect (because redirect is 'error'), or when the body is the JSON literal null so that owner.protocol cannot be read.

errors.name: TimeoutError
errors.description: Raised when a probe does not complete within 1000 ms, because each request is bounded by AbortSignal.timeout(1000).

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: Raised by JSON.parse when a response with an ok status and a body of at most 2048 characters is not valid JSON.
